final_text:
Wrote `impact.txt` with the two call sites found.

A repo-wide grep for `_check_nested_chain` (and the looser `nested_chain`) turned up only three hits: the definition at `src/click/core.py:82` and two uses. No test file, doc, or other module references it — the helper is private and not imported anywhere else.

- `src/click/core.py#Group.add_command` — line 1788, `_check_nested_chain(self, name, cmd, register=True)`
- `src/click/core.py#CommandCollection.get_command` — line 2162, `_check_nested_chain(self, cmd_name, rv)`

Both uses are directly in the method bodies (no nested closures), and note they differ in arity: `add_command` passes the `register=True` keyword, so a signature change has to account for both call shapes. Nothing else was modified.
